title: Application Security Engineer Advancement roadmap
summary: A step-by-step plan to deepen expertise, showcase impact, and prepare for senior roles. Focuses on advanced techniques, leadership, and interview readiness.

phases.title: Foundations refresh
phases.summary: Reinforce core security concepts and communication fundamentals.

milestones.title: Secure Coding refresher
milestones.outcome: Can write code that resists common vulnerabilities.

tasks.title: Read OWASP Top 10
tasks.description: Review the OWASP Top 10 page on the official site and note examples for each category.

tasks.title: Complete Secure Coding module on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the Secure Coding certification unit, completing all challenges.

tasks.title: Write a Secure function in Python
tasks.description: Implement a function that safely handles user input, applying input validation and output encoding.

tasks.title: Reflect on past bugs
tasks.description: Document two recent bugs you fixed and map them to OWASP categories.

milestones.title: Auth & crypto basics review
milestones.outcome: Can explain and apply fundamental authentication and encryption mechanisms.

tasks.title: Study RFC 6749 (OAuth 2.0) summary
tasks.description: Read the OAuth 2.0 RFC overview on the IETF site and summarize grant types.

tasks.title: Implement JWT verification in Node
tasks.description: Write a small Node script that validates a JWT using a public key.

tasks.title: Practice symmetric encryption with OpenSSL
tasks.description: Encrypt and decrypt a file using AES-256-CBC via OpenSSL commands.

tasks.title: Explain crypto concepts to a peer
tasks.description: Give a 5-minute informal talk to a colleague about hashing vs. encryption.

milestones.title: Developer communication foundations
milestones.outcome: Can convey security findings clearly to engineering teams.

tasks.title: Read Google’s Security communication guide
tasks.description: Skim the public guide and note three best-practice tips for bug reports.

tasks.title: Draft a sample Security issue ticket
tasks.description: Create a mock JIRA ticket describing a XSS finding with reproducible steps.

tasks.title: Role-play a Security review meeting
tasks.description: Conduct a 10-minute mock meeting with a colleague, presenting the issue and remediation.

tasks.title: Gather feedback on clarity
tasks.description: Ask the colleague to rate the ticket’s clarity and note improvement areas.

phases.title: Core skills expansion
phases.summary: Develop advanced threat modelling, code review, and CI security tooling abilities.

milestones.title: Advanced threat modelling
milestones.outcome: Can produce detailed threat models for complex applications.

tasks.title: Read Microsoft threat modeling tool docs
tasks.description: Browse the official documentation and list the main threat-modeling steps.

tasks.title: Model an open-source web app
tasks.description: Create a data-flow diagram and STRIDE analysis for a popular GitHub project using the tool.

tasks.title: Validate model with peer review
tasks.description: Share the model with a security colleague and incorporate their feedback.

tasks.title: Document lessons learned
tasks.description: Write a brief post-mortem summarizing challenges and solutions.

milestones.title: Secure code review
milestones.outcome: Can lead thorough security code reviews and mentor others.

tasks.title: Study OWASP code review guide
tasks.description: Read the guide on OWASP and highlight key review checkpoints.

tasks.title: Conduct a full review of a PR
tasks.description: Pick a recent pull request from an open-source repo and perform a security review using the checklist.

tasks.title: Create a review checklist template
tasks.description: Build a reusable checklist document for your team, covering the top 20 findings.

tasks.title: Teach checklist to junior Engineer
tasks.description: Run a 15-minute walkthrough of the checklist with a junior teammate.

milestones.title: CI Security tooling integration
milestones.outcome: Can embed automated security tests into CI pipelines.

tasks.title: Explore GitHub Actions Security marketplace
tasks.description: Browse the marketplace, note three actions for SAST, secret scanning, and dependency checks.

tasks.title: Add SAST action to sample repo
tasks.description: Configure a GitHub Actions workflow that runs a free SAST tool on each push.

tasks.title: Run Dependency-Check in CI
tasks.description: Integrate OWASP Dependency-Check into the pipeline and verify reports appear.

tasks.title: Write a post-mortem on false positives
tasks.description: Document any false positives encountered and how you tuned the tool.

phases.title: Proof of work (portfolio)
phases.summary: Create tangible artifacts that demonstrate expertise to employers.

milestones.title: Threat model portfolio piece
milestones.outcome: A polished threat-model document ready for public sharing.

tasks.title: Select open-source app
tasks.description: Choose a widely used open-source application to model (e.g., Mattermost).

tasks.title: Produce full threat model
tasks.description: Complete data-flow diagram, STRIDE analysis, and mitigation recommendations.

tasks.title: Publish on GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Create a repository, add the model as PDF, and enable GitHub Pages for viewing.

tasks.title: Write an executive summary
tasks.description: Summarize findings in a one-page brief for non-technical stakeholders.

milestones.title: CI Security pipeline project
milestones.outcome: A CI pipeline repository showcasing automated security checks.

tasks.title: Fork a sample application repo
tasks.description: Clone a simple web app repository to use as the pipeline target.

tasks.title: Configure Multi-tool workflow
tasks.description: Add SAST, secret scanning, and container scanning steps in GitHub Actions.

tasks.title: Document setup instructions
tasks.description: Write a README that explains how to run the pipeline locally and in CI.

tasks.title: Add badges for Security checks
tasks.description: Include status badges in the README to display scan results.

milestones.title: Secure-Coding guide Publication
milestones.outcome: A concise guide that can be referenced by development teams.

tasks.title: Gather common vulnerabilities
tasks.description: List the top five issues you encounter in your codebase.

tasks.title: Write guidance sections
tasks.description: Draft short sections with examples and remediation steps for each issue.

tasks.title: Design PDF layout with markdown
tasks.description: Convert the guide to a nicely formatted PDF using Pandoc.

tasks.title: Share with community
tasks.description: Post the guide on LinkedIn and relevant security forums, inviting feedback.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish leadership, interview performance, and continuous growth.

milestones.title: Leadership & mentoring
milestones.outcome: Can lead security initiatives and coach engineers effectively.

tasks.title: Read “managing the Security function” article
tasks.description: Read the free article on CSO Online and note three leadership practices.

tasks.title: Host a Security lunch-and-learn
tasks.description: Prepare a 20-minute presentation on recent threat-model findings for the dev team.

tasks.title: Create a mentorship plan
tasks.description: Outline a 3-month mentorship schedule for a junior security analyst.

tasks.title: Gather feedback from participants
tasks.description: Survey attendees after the lunch-and-learn and record improvement ideas.

milestones.title: Senior interview prep
milestones.outcome: Can confidently answer technical and behavioral senior-level interview questions.

tasks.title: Review common senior Security interview questions
tasks.description: Read the free list on Glassdoor and note answer outlines for five questions.

tasks.title: Mock system design interview
tasks.description: Partner with a peer to design a secure microservice architecture for 30 minutes.

tasks.title: Write STAR stories for leadership
tasks.description: Prepare three STAR-formatted stories highlighting communication and impact.

tasks.title: Record a technical explanation video
tasks.description: Film a 5-minute video explaining how you would secure a CI pipeline and upload privately for review.

milestones.title: Continuous growth strategy
milestones.outcome: A personal development plan that keeps skills current beyond the roadmap.

tasks.title: Subscribe to Security newsletters
tasks.description: Sign up for the OWASP and SANS newsletters and set a weekly reading habit.

tasks.title: Schedule quarterly threat-model reviews
tasks.description: Plan to revisit and update your portfolio threat model every three months.

tasks.title: Contribute to an open-source Security tool
tasks.description: Pick an issue on an open-source SAST project and submit a pull request.

tasks.title: Reflect on learning progress
tasks.description: Write a short journal entry summarizing achievements and next goals.
